rules.name: Metformin Severe Renal Impairment Contraindication
rules.clinical_risk: Fatal Lactic Acidosis due to reduced renal clearance and drug accumulation
rules.regulatory_reference: FDA Metformin Prescribing Information Section 4 (Contraindications) & Boxed Warning
rules.recommended_action: Discontinue Metformin immediately. Check venous lactate. Transition to renal-safe glycemic agent (e.g. DPP-4 inhibitor or adjusted basal insulin).

rules.name: Direct Oral Anticoagulant and NSAID Polypharmacy Co-Prescription
rules.clinical_risk: Acute Upper Gastrointestinal Hemorrhage and Severe Mucosal Bleeding
rules.regulatory_reference: FDA Eliquis Prescribing Information Section 7.1 (Drug Interactions - NSAIDs)
rules.recommended_action: Cessation of oral NSAIDs immediately. Recommend topical analgesic alternatives (lidocaine patch) or monitored acetaminophen. Schedule outpatient GI endoscopy consultation.

rules.name: ACE Inhibitor Hyperkalemia Toxicity
rules.clinical_risk: Cardiac Arrhythmia and Conduction Disturbance secondary to severe hyperkalemia
rules.recommended_action: Repeat serum potassium and basic metabolic panel within 48 hours. Consider dietary potassium restriction or reduction of ACE inhibitor dose.

rules.name: Metformin Moderate Renal Impairment Warning
rules.clinical_risk: Subacute decline in renal clearance with potential for drug accumulation
rules.regulatory_reference: FDA Metformin Prescribing Information Section 2.2 (Renal Impairment Dosing)
rules.recommended_action: Maximum daily dose should not exceed 1000 mg. Obtain eGFR monitoring at minimum every 3 months.
